topic.summary: Angle: open on the reported Innodata layoffs (about 550 in India on 26 Oct, devices and accounts cut off around lunch, termination emails said not performance-related, company has not confirmed numbers, shares fell about 26-28%). Then the viewer's own rights in India if laid off: notice period or pay in lieu of notice, full and final settlement, gratuity after 5 years, PF withdrawal or transfer, getting it in writing, first week checklist. Say reported claims as reported.
